user.title: Set up Scheduler
user.description: Scheduler adds a full-featured calendar-style scheduler to your sidebar. Schedules and their actions are managed entirely from that panel after setup - no configuration is needed here.

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Immediately run a schedule's actions, ignoring its configured time.

timeslot_id.name: Timeslot
timeslot_id.description: Optional - only run a specific timeslot within the schedule.

heating_boost.name: Heating boost
heating_boost.description: Temporarily hold a temperature on a heating program for a number of minutes, then automatically revert to its schedule.

minutes.name: Duration
minutes.description: How long to hold this temperature, in minutes.

heating_set_override.name: Heating set override
heating_set_override.description: Hold a temperature on a heating program indefinitely, or until a given time, overriding its schedule.

until.name: Until
until.description: Optional - revert back to the schedule automatically at this date/time. Leave empty to hold indefinitely.

heating_clear_override.name: Heating clear override
heating_clear_override.description: Clear any active boost/hold override on a heating program, returning it to its schedule.

program_id.name: Heating program
program_id.description: The heating program to clear the override on.
